en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, raising it, said, 
‘Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> said:
‘Igniting the lantern before the sun sets negates the poverty’.
en.sarwar: 13. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “Al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Turning on the lamp before sunset banishes poverty.’”
